investigation.title: Remote Agents: Swarm Gateway 502 Blocking All Agent Provisioning Evals (production-api)
investigation.summary: All three remote-agents checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-10-13T12:42–12:43Z with an identical 502 bad_gateway error: the production-api's POST /api/agents call could not reach the swarm gateway ELB at /v1/agents. Because the failure is uniform across all sibling checks and no evidence was collected (all required fields—orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState—are missing), the swarm gateway or its upstream load balancer is the shared dependency that is unreachable, not any individual eval check or runner logic.
investigation.rootCause: The swarm gateway (an AWS ELB in us-east-2 fronting /v1/agents) was unreachable from the production-api at the time of the eval run. Every attempt to POST /api/agents returned HTTP 502 with error code bad_gateway and the message "swarm gateway unreachable during agent provisioning." Because this failure occurs before any agent is created, no evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) could be collected, causing all three remote-agents checks to fail with the same message. This is localized to the swarm gateway dependency, not to the eval runner logic or the expected-output contract definitions.
